kinds.motion: At bell {b} {name} moved option {k} ({kind}) in the council of {nation}.
kinds.call_adopted: At bell {b} the council of {nation} adopted a Strike Order {with}. Its target stays sealed until bell {S}.
kinds.call_declined: At bell {b} {name} declined the Strike Order of {nation}.
kinds.no_call: At bell {b} the council of {nation} adopted no Strike Order ({why}).
kinds.strike_result: At bell {b} the Strike Order of {nation} opened at ({p},{q}) ({kind}): {present} of its armies arrived{extra}; troops lost: {lost}.
kinds.ai_card_changed: At bell {b} the Wyll card of {name} changed: {what}.
kinds.ai_march_opened: At bell {b} {name} marched at ({p},{q}) (arrived at bell {a}); its reason is published.

no_call_why.quorum: fewer than two ballots for one option
no_call_why.human_present: no human or seat ballot was among the winner's

card_what.summary: a new self-summary (written by the AI's model, not verified)
card_what.both: a new self-summary and a goal changed state
